# Pinned Firebase browser SDK

`firebase-app-compat-12.19.0.js` and `firebase-auth-compat-12.19.0.js` are unmodified Firebase JS SDK 12.19.0 distributions retrieved from https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/12.19.0/ on 2026-10-22. Same version as the previous production CDN scripts. Served locally for reliable offline startup and service-worker auth restoration.

Upstream: https://github.com/firebase/firebase-js-sdk — Apache License 2.0: https://github.com/firebase/firebase-js-sdk/blob/main/LICENSE . Public Firebase project configuration is separate from user authentication; no user tokens are bundled.
